# Ray2Volt Solar Private Limited

> Rooftop solar for businesses, industry and homes across Andhra Pradesh, India, from branches in Srikalahasti, Tirupati, Nagari and Puttur. Ray2Volt Solar designs, installs and maintains on-grid and hybrid rooftop plants for factories, hospitals, hotels, cold storage, schools, warehouses and offices, and for homes under PM Surya Ghar. It handles APSPDCL net-metering and subsidy paperwork, and offers bank-loan support and RESCO for eligible projects. 1,000+ installations across Andhra Pradesh.

Contact: +91 9666068140 | sales@ray2voltsolar.com
Office: 1-278, J.K.Nagar, Revenue Ward No-1, Pichatur Road, Srikalahasti, Tirupati District, 517644, Andhra Pradesh, India
Business hours: Monday to Saturday, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM IST
